Q1001.reason: Notice ending a month-to-month tenancy on the last day of a period was timely and need not be notarized; serving it immediately after the tenant won on habitability is retaliatory eviction, which bars possession.

Q1008.reason: Pointing a gun is extreme and outrageous, the guard knew the barber was present and had heart disease, and the resulting heart attack is bodily harm, so third-party IIED lies without a family relationship.

Q938.reason: Effective chest compressions require the patient supine on a firm surface so the sternum can be compressed against a solid base.
